decisions.reason: It remains on the home page across both years and, as a relatively low-carrying-cost extension that can create partnerships and future deal flow, it still has option value despite being less central than the firm's machinery business.

Although a bio-based binder is somewhat farther from the firm's core equipment activities and may require meaningful follow-on commitment, it has been maintained on its own page and framed as a flagship, so the upside under continuing uncertainty still justifies retention.

This product is close to the firm's established modular waste-treatment offer, remains prominently featured on the home page, and as a flagship industrial system in a growing, R&D-intensive firm it is the strongest candidate to keep on the market.
